description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware and checking images in an OpenWrt-based environment for Kirkwood devices. It defines procedures for handling different hardware models during firmware upgrade processes.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the board name and performs specific actions based on the device model, such as storing mounting information.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures customized to specific hardware models, calling different upgrade functions or processes based on the device.
